How we work

Strategy first. Then outreach.

01

Brief and budget

You share the goal, audience and budget. We tell you honestly what is achievable before any money is spent.

02

Plan the campaign

Platform, creator mix, deliverables and timeline are mapped out before a single creator is contacted.

03

Outreach that lands

Cold DMs, cold emails and a strong personal network get us to the right creators, directly and fast.

04

Execute and manage

We negotiate, brief, track approvals and report back, so the result you get is the result you planned.

We are a new agency and we are in conversation with brands right now. Founding partners get a dedicated team and priority access to the network.
